{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Come on, you fat, ugly ''fierfeks'', come and get me...|[[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]], after setting traps in anticipation of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] aggressors|<ref name="Star Wars: Republic Commando">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref>}}
'''Fierfek''' (pronounced FEAR-fek<ref name="Star Wars: Republic Commando" />) was a [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] slang word that meant "hex" or "curse," but was commonly accepted to mean "poison" by non-Huttese-speaking races, most commonly [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was adopted by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] as a curse word. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] would later use it during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].
